advisories.reason: Only via react-admin 5.15.5 (ra-core -> query-string 7 -> decode-uri-component 0.2). No compatible fix: 0.5.x is ESM-only and breaks query-string 7. Impact: a crafted URL can hang the tab of a staff member in the admin panel, which is staff-only and behind Cloudflare Access. Remove when react-admin updates query-string.
Same dependency path and impact as GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr.
